subject: This week: Ryan Peek on working with time-series data

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: This week: Ryan Peek on working with time-series data
parts:
Hi all,

At D-RUG this week Ryan Peek will give a presentation on working with time-series data collected from the field, using his own work as an example. From Ryan:

"Working with logger data collected at various intervals for temperature or flow can often be difficult. By applying the xts package, it is possible to re-aggregate time-series data at intervals of your choosing quite easily (i.e., from 15 minutes to hourly or daily). I'll show a brief example and then use ggplot to produce a few figures from time-series data."

As per usual, we will meet Wed 3-5PM in Wickson 2124, and I will provide snacks.  Presentation for the first ~30 mins, work-and-help session for the rest.

Noam
